commit.message:
fix: error check the result of encrypt_precompute

It can fail when the supplied public key is bad (see libsodium).

memzero over the shared key on failure is not needed. The array is
either not touched, or already all zero.

tcp-relay'd onion paths are annoying, since they set the pubkey for the
first hop to zero, so this is now worked around.

tcp-relay'd onion paths are annoying, since they set the pubkey for the
